hypothesis: Blind review in an independently isolated different-family runtime detects seeded defects missed by a same-family reviewer.
accept_when: two independently exposed model families are verified and cross_family_incremental_detection_rate > 0
refute_when: two verified families are available and cross_family_incremental_detection_rate <= 0
unsupported_when: a different-family reviewer cannot be dispatched or its model identity cannot be verified
